title: Carriage House at Timber Ridge!
description:
Nestled in the middle of nine wooded acres, This BRAND NEW carriage house has soaring cathedral ceilings with architectural beams, a slate-surround wood burning fireplace, and a 65” smart tv.  The kitchen features stainless appliances and butcher block counters. One bedroom features a king bed, while the other has a gorgeous queen sleigh bed. The deck in the rear of the house allows for beautiful views of the forest. And the fire pit area is sure to be a hit with your group. Fiber Internet!

The space
Expect to feel as though you are in a smoky mountain retreat.  The Carriage House was carved out of a wooded hillside, which allows for spectacular views. Large smart TV’s in both bedrooms and the living room.

Guest access
The entire 1,000 square-foot living area will be yours and yours alone. Parking is along side the stairway that leads to the unit. Owners utilize the garage portion underneath

Other things to note
We took special pains to ensure the space is quiet. We isolated the garage portion from the living portion with double the amount of insulation normally used, a layer of sound insulation board, belt driven garage door motors, and upgraded hardware to make garage door operation quieter.
